```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(car)
library(glmnet)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

setwd('/Users/fangsiyu/Desktop/sdu-2026-code/817_statistic_modeling/project')
df <- read.csv("data/examdata.csv")
df$height <- df$height * 100

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 1.1: PCA 計算與繪圖
# ==============================================================================
pca_res <- prcomp(df[, -c(1, 2)], center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pc1 <- pca_res$x[, 1]
pc2 <- pca_res$x[, 2]

point_colors <- ifelse(df$sex == "F", "red", "blue")

# 繪圖 (這會直接出現在 PDF 裡)
plot(pc1, pc2, 
     col = point_colors,
     pch = 16,
     xlab = "PC1", 
     ylab = "PC2", 
     main = "PCA, by Sex")

legend("topright",
       legend = c("F", "M"),
       col = c("red", "blue"),
       pch = 16)

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 1.2: 使用 kable 產出 PCA 摘要表格
# ==============================================================================

# 提取重要性資訊
pca_importance <- as.data.frame(summary(pca_res)$importance)

# 產出符合 PDF 格式的表格
kable(pca_importance, 
      digits = 3, 
      caption = "PCA 變異數解釋比例摘要",
      align = "c") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"), 
                full_width = F) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Principal Components" = ncol(pca_importance)))
```

          model.names = FALSE,            # 隱藏預設的模型名稱

          covariate.labels = c("身高", "腹圍", "年齡", "手腕", "截距")) # 設定變數名稱
